description: This PHP source file defines the LanguageTranslationController class which extends an abstract controller for handling language translation-related functionalities within the OrangeHRM system. It manages pre-render logic for setting component properties based on language data, including fetching language details and handling errors.

classes.name: LanguageTranslationController
classes.description: Controller class that manages the language translation editing interface by preparing components with language data for rendering.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Pre-render hook that initializes the translation component with language data by fetching language details using languageId from the request; throws exception if language is not valid or enabled.
